national.headline: Evidence-based talks with India
national.line: Federal minister Musadik Malik stated that any future dialogue with India regarding terrorism must be founded on credible evidence.

national.headline: Online document attestation by IBCC
national.line: Starting January 1, 2027, the IBCC will launch an online system, removing the requirement for students to visit offices or use couriers.

national.headline: Portuguese Foreign Minister visits Pakistan
national.line: Paulo Rangel arrived in Pakistan for a two-day official visit upon the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar.

national.headline: Oman and Pakistan energy pact
national.line: Pakistan and Oman signed an agreement for petroleum supplies and a $200 million credit facility to help diversify energy sources.

national.headline: Pakistan hosts IAEA nuclear network meeting
national.line: Islamabad is hosting the 15th annual meeting of the International Network for Nuclear Security Training and Support Centres until November 26.

national.headline: Ordinances reduce KP lawmaker privileges
national.line: President Zardari issued five ordinances removing several privileges of KP MPAs, including their protection from preventive detention.

national.headline: Textile exports grow
national.line: Pakistan's textile and clothing exports increased by 6.35 percent to $6.797 billion during the first four months of the current fiscal year.

international.headline: COP31 climate talks fail
international.line: UN climate negotiations collapsed after the European Union and other parties rejected a draft deal they considered insufficient to combat global warming.

international.headline: Pakistani citizen injured in Bahrain attack
international.line: A Pakistani national was among two people wounded in recent Iranian attacks on Bahrain, amid escalating regional tensions.

international.headline: US court summons Indian officials
international.line: A US federal court issued summons for India’s National Security Adviser and a former intelligence chief regarding an alleged murder conspiracy.

international.headline: US seeks permanent Iran deal
international.line: President Trump expressed his intent to secure a permanent agreement with Iran as regional tensions continue to impact the Strait of Hormuz.

international.headline: Houthis claim refinery attack
international.line: Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed they attacked a Saudi oil refinery, while the Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting a drone.
